description: Spike with two harts advertising different kinds — rvv0@hart0, scalar0@hart1. Used to spike-debug the firesim-generated cross-kind schedule (re-ingest with --cpu-p-kind rvv --cpu-e-kind scalar). Spike is a software ISA simulator so both harts physically run rv64gcv_zicntr; the kind label is purely a routing hint to the xpurt walker so it picks the matching per-backend dispatch table. Spike --p4 is fine — we only use harts 0/1, harts 2/3 stay idle. Used to flush out concurrent-cross-kind synchronization bugs without paying a FireSim turnaround.
